lootr.config.particles.decay_particles.d: Containers that are actively decaying will display particles to indicate this. [default: true]
lootr.config.particles.refresh_particles: Containers that are actively refreshing will display particles to indicate this. [default: true]
lootr.configuration.break_to_drop_loot.d: If true, breaking a container will mark it as opened and drop the player's loot, if broken while sneaking. [default: false]
lootr.configuration.loot_table_force_whi: List of loot tables which should be forcefully removed from the blacklist, regardless of whether or not other mods or add-ons add them to the list.
lootr.configuration.pinned_team_resolver: If blank, this will resolve to `lootr:default`, which will use the highest priority resolver. If you have multiple resolvers installed with the same priority, you can use this to specifically select the one you want to use. [default: blank]
lootr.configuration.team.desc: Configuration options for instanced team loot instead of instanced player loot.
lootr.configuration.team_loot.desc: If true, containers will create one inventory for each player's team, rather than for each player [default: false]
